newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$800 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$800 mln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$800 million of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$500 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes.
The RBA said it would take up an additional A$500 million of the 13-week notes and A$200 million of the 26-week notes for its own portfolio.

There was no tender last week but the previous week saw the Treasury offer a total of A$500 million of notes, comprising A$200 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes. There are A$863 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending September 11.
